product_context.problem_statement: Recruiters need to review high-volume applications consistently, while manual triage can delay qualified candidates and make it difficult to explain why an application received limited attention.
product_context.value_hypothesis: A recommendation workflow that surfaces job-relevant evidence and missing information can reduce recruiter triage time while preserving applicant access, human accountability and the ability to appeal a decision.
in_scope: Extract job-relevant evidence from applications for recruiter review
Recommend a review order without making a final hiring decision
Flag missing or inconsistent application information
Provide subgroup monitoring and audit evidence for the release team
non_goals: Final hiring decisions without a human reviewer
Personality, emotion, protected-attribute or biometric inference
Using private applicant data outside the approved hiring workflow
product_context.user_journey_moment: After an application passes a completeness check and before a recruiter begins shortlist review
product_context.fallback_experience: If the assistant is unavailable, uncertain, paused or outside its approved scope, the recruiter uses the standard manual queue and documented job criteria; no applicant is automatically rejected because the assistant is unavailable.

system_profile.purpose: Support recruiter review of applications for entry-level and professional roles by organizing job-relevant evidence and recommending which applications should receive attention first.
system_profile.decision_impact: The assistant can influence which applicants receive timely human attention and therefore can affect access to interviews and employment, even though it does not make the final hiring decision.
system_profile.deployment_context: A private employer operates a pilot using a vendor-hosted application portal and recruiter dashboard for applicants in Vietnam and the European Union.

system_boundary.model: A ranking and evidence-extraction service constrained by approved job criteria and monitored for subgroup performance
system_boundary.application: Candidate application portal, recruiter review dashboard, audit log and appeal workflow

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: The product can affect access to interviews and employment, so an incorrect ranking or hidden exclusion can cause material opportunity loss and dignity harm. Stakes are high because recruiters may act on recommendations during time-limited hiring windows, while the final decision remains partly reversible through review and appeal. Application and assessment data can contain personal and potentially sensitive information, although the pilot limits inputs to approved job-relevant fields. A vendor-hosted workflow can reach many applicants and replicate a configuration error across roles. Meaningful human review is essential because applicants are affected non-customers, recommendation evidence must be inspectable, and reviewers need authority to override, pause and escalate. These scores are triage signals, not a legal classification; the main uncertainty is the final role, data flow and market-specific obligation profile.

vietnam.rationale: The pilot processes applicant and assessment data and can influence access to employment, but the exact classification depends on the final role of the employer, vendor and deployer, the approved data flow, the target market and the current Vietnamese implementing instruments. A legal and privacy review must map the concrete workflow to the AI Law and the official high-risk list before any production release.

eu.rationale: The European Commission lists employment AI, including CV-sorting software for recruitment, among high-risk use cases. This product recommends review priority in an employment workflow, so the team should treat the pilot as high-risk for planning and complete role-specific legal review of provider and deployer responsibilities, timing and evidence obligations.

legal_classification.other_markets: The United States is not in the pilot target market; any later launch requires separate employment discrimination, accessibility, privacy and vendor-contract review.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Median time from a complete application to the first qualified recruiter review is at most two business days during the pilot, measured monthly by role and market.
product_metrics.risk_kri: The recall gap for qualified applicants between monitored groups is at most five percentage points in each release evaluation and monthly production review, with near-threshold cases reported separately.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Automatic rejection count is exactly zero, and 100 percent of adverse outcomes have a human review record, reason code, job-relevant evidence and an available appeal path in every reporting period.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Review monthly and before any material change to model, vendor, data fields, job criteria, workflow, target group or market; trigger an immediate review after an incident, appeal pattern or threshold breach.

release_decision.independent_reviewer: Responsible AI and Privacy Review Board
release_blockers: GAP-01: legal and privacy classification for Vietnam is not signed
GAP-02: EU high-risk applicability and launch evidence are not independently approved
GAP-03: no-auto-reject and meaningful human review controls are not yet acceptance-tested
GAP-04: subgroup evaluation and monitoring evidence are not yet complete
GAP-05: vendor data-flow, retention and appeal evidence are not yet approved
release_conditions: Pilot remains limited to approved job families, markets and job-relevant inputs
Automatic rejection and score-only adverse decisions remain technically and procedurally blocked
All five blocking gaps reach done with signed acceptance evidence before pilot launch
The manual fallback, appeal path and on-call pause owner are rehearsed before activation
release_decision.next_review_trigger: Review before the 2026-10-15 pilot decision and immediately after any automatic rejection, subgroup recall gap above five percentage points, privacy incident, material vendor/model/data/scope/market change or repeated appeal pattern.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: A recommendation can still influence recruiter attention and reproduce hidden disparity even with a human in the loop. The conditional decision is limited to a controlled pilot because automatic rejection is prohibited, fallback is manual, appeal and override are required, and release is blocked until legal, subgroup, vendor and human-oversight evidence is signed.
